why_it_matters: Confirm every variable is measured at the intended time and does not include future leakage.
Decide whether variables are observed causes, outcomes, mediators, selection variables, or environment indices.
Choose methods and tests that match continuous, discrete, mixed, or time-series data.
Decide whether causal sufficiency is plausible; if not, consider FCI-style methods.
Check whether conditional independence tests or score searches are realistic for the number of variables.
Collect required or forbidden edges before looking at results when possible.
Plan to vary alpha, scores, bootstrap samples, or algorithm families.
State that the output is a candidate graph unless stronger validation is available.
